results.title: Trump caps USA's 250th birthday summer with Indy race through Washington
results.description: WASHINGTON - ​President Donald Trump will cap the celebration of the U.S. 250th ‌anniversary with a first-of-its-kind auto race through the streets of Washington, closing a summer defined by sports and spectacle as drivers speed past some of the capital's most iconic landmarks.

results.title: Dutch Grand Prix sees a potential path back to F1 amid Middle East uncertainty
results.description: The Dutch Grand Prix is bidding goodbye to Formula 1 but its organizers say it could potentially return as an “alternative venue” amid continuing uncertainty over next year’s schedule.
